Source contracts: scripts/binary_archive.py

scripts/binary_archive.py

Python · Tier B

Create and verify native release archives for build and acceptance tooling.

Usage

Build owners call create_archive after signing; acceptance tools call extract_artifact.

Inputs

A finished artifact, target platform, optional resolved archive tools and manifest hashes.

Side effects

Platform tools compress archives; extraction writes a private directory and may verify signatures. This standard-library module does not install dependencies or run the application.

Cleanup

Temporary archive staging is context-owned; callers own retained extraction/output paths.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py

@see scripts/binary_builder.py

@note Validate entry paths, types, CRCs and expected hashes before publishing or extracting content.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
digest 30 Not yet documented
archive_tools 35 Resolve native tools before staging, without accepting a Git Bash tar on Windows.
_inventory 68 Read all file bytes, validating CRCs, paths and entry types before extraction.
create_archive 123 Package a finished, signed artifact; publish its archive only after validation.
verify_signature 205 Verify the extracted platform signature, without requiring Windows build tools.
extract_artifact 238 Verify the shipped hash, extract into a private directory and return its launcher. Older raw executables and ZIP manifests remain readable, including historical Linux ZIPs with a staging-path prefix. No extracted path may escape the directory.
